limits.en: Starter plan: 5 active forms, 100 monthly submissions, Jotform branding included.

keyLimits.en: 50 active forms, 2,500 submissions/month, 10 GB upload space
100 active forms, 10,000 submissions/month, 100 GB storage, HIPAA-friendly option
Unlimited forms/submissions, SSO, HIPAA, data residency, dedicated support

cautions.en: Monthly billing costs noticeably more than annual (e.g. Bronze $39/mo monthly vs $34/mo billed annually).
50% nonprofit/education discount on Bronze/Silver/Gold, 30% on Enterprise, is a separate program not reflected in list prices.

capabilities.en: Drag-and-drop form builder with 10,000+ templates covering surveys, orders, applications and more.
Built-in payment collection and workflow automations tied to form submissions.
Includes AI Agents (chat-based form assistants) with a usage allowance that scales per plan.

limitations.en: Free Starter plan caps at 5 active forms and 100 submissions/month, quickly outgrown by any real use case.
Submission and form-count caps apply on every paid tier up to Gold; only Enterprise removes them, at custom pricing.

reason.en: More design-focused conversational form builder, a common alternative for polished lead forms.
Free, simpler form builder alternative for teams that don't need Jotform's breadth.
Newer form builder with a generous free tier, positioned as a lighter Typeform/Jotform alternative.
